title: felicia amoena subsp. stricta
intro: Felicia amoena subsp. stricta, commonly known as Blue Felicia, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Blue Felicia are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Blue Felicia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
